arithmetic_contract: Coarse64/128/256 production explicitly sums zero-C signed and absolute K16 matrix products. The unchanged bound includes conditional native2^-19 error, explicit FP32 summation error and every original canonical K16 carry/alignment/normalization loss. Whole-row eligibility is checked independently; unsupported rows receive infinite error and original score replay. Possible prefix maxima and BF16 probability boundaries are exactly repaired, then original monotone denominator interval recurrence and BF16 output certificates determine acceptance. The output margin only selects refinement work; complete uncertain-row replay remains final fallback. The known incorrect approximate-denominator runtime helper is not invoked. The selected prepared canonical QK and all reference values are comparison-only.
correctness_scope: Each producer completes35 generated cases and the complete q7169 and q8192 component. Every live score interval, BF16 probability, FP32 alpha, denominator interval and final output is checked. All q7169 context cells and the original7169-row prefix of the q8192 extension match the external GB10 BF16 artifact. The additional1023 causal outputs match canonical computation but have no new external oracle. Every slab tail, complete prepared operand and original input is checked. Exact source, command, binary and reference identities are attached. Native error assumptions remain conditional and finite comparisons do not prove a universal hardware bound.
timing_scope: Each producer/shape process is one completed diagnostic attempt, with no warmup or median claim. Completed QK and repair/probability clocks include their fences and interval/certificate work; candidate PV is canonical for every output. Selected QK preparation, candidate key transpose and coarse eligibility are explicit. Allocation, host uploads/downloads, reset, baseline comparisons and slab-tail checks are outside these component clocks; bounded process walls include them. This is not the deployed approximate-PV-plus-exact-replay pipeline, a real model prompt, TTFT or token-generation benchmark.

decision.decision: Keep all coarse selective QK producers isolated. The unchanged strict output certificate preserves every external GB10 context cell, but the q8192 control/C64/C128/C256 cases still replay85.6841/85.8366/88.2941/91.5505percent of scores. Complete producer, repair and probability stages cost3326.0542/3418.3101/3420.8149/3459.7018ms before their separately measured canonical PV, compared to roughly448-450ms for selected prepared QK plus original probability. Changing coarse production does not solve the strict denominator bottleneck. Preserve denominator correctness and the current model route; pivot to structural exact-replay or other dominant operator work.
